ns2:section.sectionText: This course examines historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCU) from the antebellum period through the contemporary era. In so doing, particular attention is paid to the broader historical contexts that shaped the development of informal and formal “education,” whereby African Americans’ larger struggle for enfranchisement worked in tangent to uphold ideals of education as a quest for freedom.
